studies.notes: Checked the complete markdown conversion and the supplied author-manuscript PDF, identified in the retrieval and citation records as PsyArXiv tbvq2_v1. Appendices A and B are included in this PDF and are the supplements named in the extraction file; the later ACM proceedings version was not used. The main creativity analyses use third-party ratings of submitted ideas (PDF p. 15, Results, Individual-Level Creativity; PDF p. 35, Table A2). Neither these models nor the homogeneity analyses print the number of distinct submitters analyzed. The reported submitter sample is followed by explicit complete exclusions for AI noncompliance (PDF pp. 13-14), so it cannot be used as n_analyzed. Trials without chat data were also excluded, and ideas never sampled for evaluation were excluded from the rating analysis (PDF p. 13, Evaluation Phase and Manipulation Checks). No post-exclusion participant total was calculated. Random assignment is described on PDF p. 11, Submission Phase, but no count at assignment is printed. The additional submitter attention-check exclusions on PDF p. 10 have no stated timing relative to assignment; a total including everyone enrolled is not printed either. The reported recruitment sample is therefore retained in other_counts rather than treated as a confirmed n_randomized. No arm enrollment or analyzed counts are printed; arm-specific exclusions are retained in other_counts. Tables A2-A3 (PDF pp. 35-36) report observation counts, not counts of distinct people. Appendix B and the figure notes supply no missing participant totals. No count was inferred from observations, ideas, degrees of freedom, plot points, or arithmetic on other counts. All quoted passages were matched to whitespace-normalized PDF text; PDF and printed page numbers coincide.
